use default
use Ghul.Coroutines

let names = ["Ann", "Bill", "Cid"]
let turns = [1, 3, 2]
let cycles = 3

let gate = SEMAPHORE(0)
let finished = LIST[string]()

let arrived mut = 0

release_others() is
    for _ in 1..names.count do
        gate.release()
    od
si

checkpoint() -> COROUTINE is
    arrived = arrived + 1

    if arrived < names.count then
        await gate.acquire()
    else
        arrived = 0

        write_line("assembled {finished |> join(", ")}")

        finished.clear()

        release_others()
    fi
si

worker(seat: int) -> COROUTINE is
    let name = names[seat]

    for cycle in 1::cycles do
        for _ in 1::turns[seat] do
            await pause()
        od

        write_line("{name} finished part {cycle}")

        finished.add("{name}'s part {cycle}")

        await checkpoint()
    od
si

for seat in 0..names.count do
